remarks_1999: Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Back; OK initials and star. Back: O'Keeffe writing: "Dark Mesa – Pink Sky – 30'" [not verified]. Pictured in 1931 New York (An American Place) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 43. "This is a very good one. The mountain is a very dark rich green— Hills have earth red in them—sky pale pink," written by O'Keeffe on photograph of work owned by The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation (Now housed at the Georgia O'Keeffe Museum). See cat. no. 1902. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Dark Mesa And Pink Sky

description: Under a large, black mesa, red, orange, and white hills ripple across the canvas. The hills and mesa are smooth and have soft variations in tone and color. A thin strip of pale pink sky hangs above the landscape.
